record.body:
## Description

Add ~/se-workflow/tests/test_dashboard_integration.py. It creates a temp git repo, copies the contract, runs resolve and init through the CLI, then creates a goal, a phase and two dependent work-items. It moves them through planned, in_progress and done, adds a blocking question, and back-dates one done item beyond 24h. After each step it renders view --id project:dashboard and asserts which section each record appears in. Then run both full suites and render the dashboard against ~/.artifacts/se-workflow. Waits for add-dashboard-view.

payload.title: Integration-test the dashboard view and verify phase 1

record.subject: verify-dashboard-view-phase
